title: generated files out of date
how: norn gen --check (the machine's generated harness files): a PROBLEM line is a finding only when the source it names is a file the diff touches - drift in a file whose source no branch changed (a home-folder agent file edited by hand) never holds one

explain.what: A generated file (an agent file, AGENTS.md and the like) no longer matches what `norn gen` writes from its sources.
explain.why: Workers read the generated files. A stale one gives them old instructions, and a hand edit is lost at the next generation.
explain.fix: Run `norn gen` and commit the result. Change the source, not the generated file.

recorded.head:
PROBLEM C:/p/.claude/agents/implementer.md: stale (sources changed since generation; run norn gen) [source agents/implementer.md]
gen --check: 1 problem(s)

PROBLEM C:/p/.claude/agents/implementer.md: drift (edited after generation; never overwritten) [source agents/implementer.md]
gen --check: 1 problem(s)
